name: Longer Ray5 40W
tagline: 40W Compact fixed-focus diode — simple desk engraver for small projects
tldr: Longer Ray5 40W is the 40W SKU on the Longer longer ray5 line. Longer's compact Ray5 20W diode engraver — verify you are buying the 20W SKU, not the 5W, 10W, or 40W Ray5 listings. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.

priceRange.note: 40W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Touchscreen and fixed focus simplify first jobs
Good as a second machine for small engravings
cons: Less rigid frame than Sculpfun/Ortur at similar prices
Fixed focus limits flexibility on uneven items
Limited upgrade path vs. modular competitors
beginnerNotes: Choose 40W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: Use a riser or rotary for tumblers if your model supports it. LightBurn improves workflow vs. stock app. Keep expectations on cutting — this is an engraver first.
primaryUse: Compact desktop engraving of small wood, leather, and slate items with minimal setup complexity.
mainObjective: Fast hobby engraving and cutting — thicker basswood, dark acrylic, and shorter job times
